title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1978-10-22
lineage: Nakamichi CR3A w/ Dolby > Audigy 4 Pro @ 24/44.1 > Editing with NERO > Tracked With CD Wave > Dithered to 16 bit with Audacity > Flac (level 8).
source: 2 Sony ecm-280 microphones (shoulder high) > Teac PC-10 w/ Dolby > TDK SA-C90 tape. Our location was on the floor under the mirrored ball about 20-25 feet from the stage dead center.

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality audience tape with minimal hiss and a strong first set; second set picks up after Fire when drums kick in.
ai_review.review: The two fan reviews agree this is an audience source that generally sounds clear, with one noting a bit of hiss while the other praises its low noise level. Musically the show shines in the opening set (especially the early material) and although the second set feels a little thin before the drums come back after "Fire," it recovers nicely once the rhythm section is fully in.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating of 4 from reviewers, strong positive comments about the first set and overall tape quality offset by a single note on hiss.

recording_quality.technical_notes: One reviewer mentions noticeable hiss and possible generational loss; another says hiss is very low, calling it the best sounding audience source for this show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as great; second set feels a bit lacking before drums re-enter after "Fire," then improves markedly.
